title: What to do if your credit card statement shows a fraudulent charge
desc: Dispute unauthorized transactions and protect your account from ongoing fraud.
todos: Call the official customer service number on the back of your card immediately to report the transaction.
Request an instant freeze on the compromised card and order a new card with a new account number.
File an official billing dispute for the specific fraudulent charge to initiate chargeback protection.
Review recent pending transactions for any small test charges from unfamiliar vendors.
Update recurring billing payments once your replacement card arrives in the mail.
